facts.fact: The document is the Schéma Directeur de la Statistique 2020-2024 of the Conseil national de la statistique, dated March 2020, with a logical framework and costed activities for the national statistical system; it does not state its approval date, so it is dated by the document.

The document's contents list a section drawing lessons from the evaluation of the SDS 2015-2019 and a synthesis of its implementation, including an achievement rate; the evaluation's own date is not given, so it is dated by the SDS 2020-2024 document.
